row: OWR-4530-006 (30001608): All-load stability of the deterministic-first-chunk chain

All-load stability of a deterministic-first-chunk file-sharing chain — Alec Kriebel, v1.0 (2026-10-20). Six-page research note: nonexplosion, irreducibility and positive recurrence in physical continuous time for every fixed real arrival rate lambda>0 in the exact six-rate four-population model with a permanent seed, invisible empty waiting rooms and immediate completed-peer departure. The contribution is the all-load extension; the classical elementary workload argument already handles lambda<1/2. Bounded priority review compares the historical OWR conjecture, January 5, 2011 author proof and actual Allerton 2012 protocol; final 2011/2015 publisher bodies and some later bodies were not inspected. No worldwide-firstness/current-openness certificate, stationary moment or other-protocol conclusion is asserted. Two fresh sequential complete-package adversarial AI reviews passed. Extensive AI involvement in research, proofs, computations, writing and auditing; unrefereed, without formal independent human peer review. Published PDF and portable source/verification ZIP: https://zenodo.org/records/23524971; original PR https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/292.
